pairs.subject: deployment-contract
pairs.evidence: src/stores/slices/system/cloudSlice.ts:139 In this context "deploy" means the product feature of placing a user's persona onto a cloud or GitLab agent runtime, driven through IPC from Zustand client state. Nothing here builds, uploads, caches or promotes this repository's own artifact to a hosting platform, and a search of src/stores for vercel, netlify, cache-control, dockerignore and max-age found no hits, so the subject's precondition (a repository delivering its build through a host) does not hold for these files.

techniques.evidence: src/stores/slices/system/cloudSlice.ts:131 Undeploy is about user persona deployments on a remote runtime, not about renaming or retiring this repo's hosted endpoint.
src/stores/slices/system/gitlabSlice.ts:92 Redeploying a persona agent to GitLab is a feature action. There is no preview-to-production promotion of this repo's build.
src/stores/slices/system/deployTarget.ts:2 The abstraction only translates errors and connection state for the feature's targets. No hosted build or build inputs are involved.
